name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
title: Triveni Turbine Ltd - 533655 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue record ₹6.8bn (+26%) but margin compressed on NTPC low-margin order and MTM loss; receivables swelled to ₹6.39bn (84 days vs 49), closing order book +8% to ₹20.54bn.

triggers.label: Receivable days 84 vs 49
triggers.quote: The average trade receivable days stood at 84 days versus 49 days as of the 31st of March 2025.

triggers.label: Export orders record ₹5.16bn, +174%
triggers.quote: Export orders booking touched a record high of ₹5.16 billion during the quarter, registering a growth of 174% year -over-year

triggers.label: Closing order book +8% to ₹20.54bn
triggers.quote: resulting in our closing outstanding order book increasing by 8% year-on-year to ₹20.54 billion.

triggers.label: Q4 margin compression on mix and MTM
triggers.quote: the margin compression was principally due to a change in segmental mix

guidance.value: ~9% growth in enquiry closing order book cited as minimum growth indication
guidance.quote: what we do have is a growth in the enquiry closing order book by about 9%
this year, we believe exports would be more than the domestic.
we believe that this current year should be positive, if not at worst breakeven.

red_flags.label: Receivables 84 days, ₹6.39bn
red_flags.quote: receivables at the end of March 31, 2026, stood at ₹6.39 billion

red_flags.label: Low-margin NTPC strategic order; BESS project cost overruns
red_flags.quote: which has already had some cost increases. But having absorbed those, the project is still marginally profitable.

evasions.quote: we shy away from giving direct giving guidance
It's difficult to answer your question about have your margins bottomed out.
Right now, we would like to finish our current project before we actually project out what our business plan will be for that.
